... if 20 or more players are involved.

Since there were only 19 players at the Northwest USA qualifier, only
the top 9 (half rounded down) qualify (as the decklist linking
indicates on the NW page).

Note also that previously-qualified players are not counted when looking
for the top-10 (or tap half) players at these events.
